messages:
maya-g: Quick async check-in for the us-west-4 cutover — putting the minimal readiness checklist here. Need owners to confirm ETA or blockers. Items: 1) regional routing policy + canary, 2) customer-managed KMS key + rotation policy, 3) cloud peering (or transit fallback), 4) DB replica + quotas. @sam-k routing, @li-zhang KMS, @priya-r peering. Paste of routing snippet below for review:

maya-g: ```json
{
  "policy": "locality-first",
  "canary": { "weight": 10 },
  "health_check_path": "/_health"
}
```

sam-k: ack. I’ll own routing. Will open PR for the policy changes today, ETA EOD. Quick question — do we prefer strict locality or weighted fallback?

maya-g: prefer locality for latency-sensitive routes; weighted fallback for cost. Canary weight 10% sounds right.

li-zhang: KMS status: waiting on security approval for CMK usage (SEC-498). I’ve drafted the key policy. If SEC signs off we can create the key tomorrow. I need infra to ensure the IAM role `redwood-usw4-kms-role` exists.

security-team: SEC-498 reviewed. Please add a key rotation paragraph to the KMS PR and we can expedite approval.

priya-r: Peering update: cloud peering request CP-7721 submitted. Cloud team is validating. If it doesn’t clear by 06:00 UTC tomorrow we’ll flip to transit-gw fallback. I’m adding that fallback to the runbook.

sam-k: Routing PR: https://github.com/redwood/routing/pull/4567 — includes region policy + canary config. Requesting review from @alex-w and infra CI.

alex-w: On it, will review in ~30m. One nit I already spotted: healthcheck path should be `/_health` not `/healthz`.

infra-bot: CI passed — build#3456 succeeded. Staging smoke deploy scheduled for 2024-05-10T09:00Z.

maya-g: Great. If routing PR merges and KMS approved we can run the canary tomorrow at 09:00Z. @oncall-bot can you add a pager for the 2h window?

oncall-bot: Pager scheduled for 2024-05-10 09:00UTC -> 11:00UTC, rotation: platform-oncall.

sam-k: Small blocker: autoscale policy needs updated limits; PR will land soon. Also need DB replica zone config confirmed — pinging DB team: @frank-db.

frank-db: DB team ok with 2 read replicas in us-west-4, min storage 2TB. Will open infra ticket to provision.

maya-g: Perfect. Final ask: owners post one-line update when done (merge/approved + ticket numbers). Readiness = green once routing PR merged, KMS key created, peering accepted (or fallback ready), DB replica ticket created/acknowledged.

priya-r: Peering accepted — CP-7721 closed, cloud accepted the peering. Fallback removed from runbook.

li-zhang: KMS created: key-id `abc123-usw4`. PR updated with rotation policy (SEC-498 resolved).

sam-k: Routing PR merged — #4567 merged at 1715554000. Autoscale PR #4570 merged as well.

frank-db: INF-908 created for replica provisioning, infra will kick off provisioning tasks.

maya-g: Two final checks: infra smoke pass and runbook updated. @alex-w can you confirm runbook change?

alex-w: Runbook updated: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/usw4-cutover.md. Staging smoke was successful at 09:15Z.

maya-g: Awesome — marking readiness green and will broadcast the rollout calendar invite. :tada:
